title: Cognitive Forge Spoke Manifest
description: Source manifest of a Cognitive Forge plugin repository (spoke): the single plugin it publishes through the registry, or an empty retirement submission. See docs/plugin-standard.md.

$schema.description: Optional schema reference for editor validation.

name.description: Spoke display identifier. Folder ownership is derived from the validated repository name.

description.description: Default description inherited by plugins; does not replace hub identity.

version.description: Legacy source metadata accepted for compatibility and ignored by hub versioning.

owner.description: Ignored: the registry applies Cognitive Forge authorship and the Apache-2.0 license to every plugin.

author.description: Ignored: the registry applies Cognitive Forge authorship and the Apache-2.0 license to every plugin.

homepage.description: Default homepage inherited by plugins unless overridden.

repository.description: Default source repository inherited by plugins unless overridden.

license.description: Ignored: the registry applies Cognitive Forge authorship and the Apache-2.0 license to every plugin.

keywords.description: Default discovery keywords inherited by plugins unless overridden.

capabilityRoot.description: Optional documentation-only hint for the capability root. The hub workflow passes the actual root to the compiler.

plugins.description: One independently versioned plugin per spoke. An empty array retires the spoke's plugin.

displayName.description: Human-readable plugin name for install surfaces.

version.description: Authoritative plugin version copied into generated manifests. Use a prerelease suffix such as 0.1.0-preview.1 for previews; a published version never changes content.

skillsPath.description: Optional directory, relative to the capability root, copied recursively into the plugin's skills/ folder. A plugin must declare at least one component: skills, commands, agents, hooks, MCP servers, or apps.

author.description: Ignored: the registry applies Cognitive Forge authorship and the Apache-2.0 license to every plugin.

license.description: Ignored: the registry applies Cognitive Forge authorship and the Apache-2.0 license to every plugin.

interface.description: Codex install-surface metadata. Values are copied into .codex-plugin/plugin.json interface.

commands.description: Command file or directory paths copied into the generated plugin and referenced from the plugin manifest.

agents.description: Agent file or directory paths copied into the generated plugin and referenced from the plugin manifest.

hooks.description: Hook config path copied into the generated plugin.

mcpServers.description: MCP config path copied into the generated plugin.

apps.description: Codex app/connector mapping path copied into the generated plugin.

assets.description: Asset file or directory paths copied into the generated plugin. LICENSE and NOTICE are added by the registry and need not be declared.

strict.description: When true, generate .claude-plugin/plugin.json for this plugin.
